thread:
Alex M: Heads up — final announce plan for next Wed 9am PT. Need eng signoff on changelog + docs links. Draft here: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/v0.9 (working copy)
Priya E: Can you paste the exact changelog snippet we want in the announcement? Want to vet any backwards-incompatible notes.
Alex M: Sure — short blurb for marketing: 'Redwood Inference v0.9 — faster streaming, caching improvements, Dedicated general availability for paid customers.' Full notes in changelog: https://redwood.ai/changelog/v0.9
Jonah P: Suggest we avoid raw "GA" language until legal signs off. Reworded above looks good.
Alex M: Good call. Updated phrasing in the draft. Priya — can you confirm rollout window: canaries Tue 02:00 PT -> full Wed 07:00 PT?
Sam R: Canaries scheduled Tue 02:00 PT in us-west1, smoke tests 30m. Fallback policy set to auto-revert to v0.8 if error rate > 5%.
Release Bot: Canary job queued — job id 98321, target pool "canary-usw1", notify on: success/fail.
Maya K: Docs updates are in PR #482: /docs/release-notes/v0.9 and console screenshots added. Link: https://redwood.ai/docs/v0.9. Screenshots will be behind feature flag until GA.
Priya E: Changelog snippet looks fine. One note: our streaming latency numbers are from internal harness; we should mark them as "preliminary internal benchmarks" and link the bench run: https://bench.redwood.ai/run/9876
Alex M: :thumbsup: We'll phrase it as "preliminary internal benchmarks" in the announcement. Also planning a webinar Thurs 10am PT — can we confirm speakers (Maya + Priya) and one slide on latency/cost?
Maya K: I can prepare docs + slides. Priya can do a 10-min deep dive demo. Jonah to moderate?
Jonah P: Yep, I can moderate and own Q&A routing. For inbound leads, marketing will tag as "v0.9-launch" and source "webinar" — Sam, do we have demo SSO accounts ready?
Sam R: Demo accounts ready in ded-demo env. SSO credentials distributed via 1Password. For lead routing, set webhook POST to https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead with payload fields: name, email, interest_level, source, utm_campaign.
Alex M: Quick checklist — copying into thread:
```
- [ ] Changelog link live
- [ ] Docs link live
- [ ] Canary scheduled
- [ ] Webinar speakers confirmed
- [ ] Lead webhook configured
- [ ] Press embargo set (Wed 08:00 PT)
```
Alex M: Who owns the press embargo line? @Jonah P?
Jonah P: I’ll own press embargo and ping legal. ETA: EOD today to confirm wording.
Priya E: One last request — add a rollback playbook section to the release doc with exact steps and runbook links. I'll open PR with the steps by EOD.
Alex M: Thanks everyone. I'll update the announcement copy to include "preliminary internal benchmarks" and post the final draft by 4pm PT today. :rocket:
